EC1: 1. Patients with active Inflammatory Bowel Disease
EC2: 2. Patients with previous history of acute diverticulitis disease [OR] or with prior incomplete colonoscopy due to diverticular disease
EC3: 3. Patients with known bowel obstruction / [OR] strictures
EC4: 4. History of prior surgery to colon [OR] and/or rectum
EC7: 7. Abnormal Liver enzymes (ALT/ [OR] AST ≥ 2 times upper limits of normal) (based on medical history)
EC8: 8. Patients taking anticoagulants drugs [OR] (excluding aspirin) or dual antiplatelet therapy
EC10: 10. Patients at risk of hypokalemia [OR] or hyponatremia
EC12: 12. Pregnancy (as stated by patient) [OR] or breast feeding
EC13: 13. Patients with altered mental status/inability to provide informed consent
EC14: 14. Patients who have participated in another interventional clinical study in the last 2 months
